title: Shah Rukh Khan Warns Aryan Khan Not To Bully Suhana Khan In Viral Video: 'I'll Kick You' | Bollywood News - News18
text: Aryan Khan and Shah Rukh Khan released the highly awaited trailer of the former’s directorial debut series The Ba***ds Of Bollywood. At the preview launch event, Aryan gave his first public statement, and Shah Rukh Khan introduced the cast of the show as well. It was indeed a proud moment for the superstar to see his son take his first step in his career. Amidst all the buzz about the new show and the father-son’s fun interaction on stage, a childhood video of Aryan Khan is doing rounds online. What Is The Clip? Shah Rukh Khan, like any doting father, was seen scolding Aryan for “bullying" his sister Suhana in an old video shot in London. The clip shows a young Aryan playing with Suhana and other kids when SRK steps in, telling his son: “You don’t cheat, You don’t win at any cost, You don’t lie and win." Later in the video, he turns into a strict yet loving father, firmly warning Aryan, “Don’t bully them, I’ll kick you." Aryan Khan-Shah Rukh Khan On Stage Banter Meanwhile, the audience enjoyed a lighthearted father-son moment at the preview launch of The Ba***ds Of Bollywood. Aryan Khan, giving his first-ever public statement, admitted he was nervous and revealed that he had been preparing for the speech over the past three nights. He joked about being so anxious that he relied on a teleprompter and even carried a handwritten note in case of a power cut. Adding to the fun, Aryan quipped that if he messed up, his father Shah Rukh Khan would step in to save him, prompting the superstar to play along, seen with a copy of the speech taped to his back Aryan Khan On The Ba***ds of Bollywood Speaking about his show, Aryan Khan said, “We’ve tried to bring a lot of entertainment to a lot of people in a lot of places. After four years of hard work, countless discussions, and thousands of takes, this show is finally ready. And I want to thank the people without whom making this show would have been impossible." The preview for Netflix’s The Ba***ds of Bollywood hints at a fast-paced drama set amidst the chaos of the entertainment industry. The show’s cast includes Bobby Deol, Lakshya, Sahher Bambba, Manoj Pahwa, Mona Singh, Manish Chaudhari, Raghav Juyal, Anya Singh, and Vijayant Kohli, as well as Rajat Bedi and Gautami Kapoor. The preview also had cameos from Salman Khan, Karan Johar, and Ranveer Singh.
